mapper.sql: a.id, a.inventory_id, a.drug_id, a.hospital_id, a.batch_no, a.expire_date, a.days_to_expire, a.alert_level, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, d.name AS drug_name, d.code AS drug_code, d.spec, d.unit, h.name AS hospital_name
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM drug_expiry_alert a LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON a.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hospital_id = h.id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.days_to_expire ASC, a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
